# Support

English or Russian, whichever is easier for you.

| You have | Where |
|---|---|
| a question: how to do something, why Nanolog behaves so | [Discussions Q&A](https://github.com/nanolaba/nanolog/discussions/categories/q-a) |
| a bug: Nanolog printed something wrong, nothing, or failed | [the bug report form](https://github.com/nanolaba/nanolog/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml) |
| an idea to talk over | [Discussions Ideas](https://github.com/nanolaba/nanolog/discussions/categories/ideas) or [the feature request form](https://github.com/nanolaba/nanolog/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml) |
| a mistake in the documentation | [the documentation form](https://github.com/nanolaba/nanolog/issues/new?template=documentation.yml) |
| a vulnerability | privately, see [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) |

## What helps to answer

- The Nanolog version and the JDK, `java -version` in one line.
- The smallest code that shows the problem, with its settings: the `-D` flags, the environment variables, `nanolog.properties`.
- The lines that start with `[NANOLOG]` on `System.err`: Nanolog reports its own problems there.
- The logger in use (console, JSON, file, SLF4J and its backend), and whether a coding agent ran the program.

## How soon

Nanolog is maintained by one person, so there is no guaranteed response time. Reports of vulnerabilities are answered first, then bugs, then questions and ideas. A question asked as an issue is answered there, not closed as the wrong place.
